quotes.text: If your neighbor sends nothing, send less — but never nothing.
Forgive the fog once. Twice, look to the post.
answer it the same morning, past the waterline, as though the lean years never happened.
Open first. Match generously. Forgive the fog twice.
He sent nothing the next morning.
If they send nothing, send something; if they send little, answer as though it were much.
The post remembers.
blame the fog before the friend.
someone must send first into the silence.
The crosser risked his whole living; you risked only waiting.
ask what you would do if the far bank were blameless.
Her sons asked which face was the law.
send nothing until the ledger is clean.
and the watching had become a habit, and the habit a drought, and he had named it patience to the end.

note: Ferry-post generations: shun Doru, then grain never nothing, forgive fog twice; Ferran and an old ferryman confess caution became drought.

quotes.text: The Sender keeps five minus S plus R; the Receiver keeps three S minus R.
asked the traveler to name the ask and the reserve
three gates stood like watchful trees: Send, Hold, Return.

note: Gate of Send/Multiply/Return with S and R ledger formulas; greed only dims lamps; no response to non-cooperators.

quotes.text: sent seven and a half glowing fruits back across the chasm, retaining the equal portion to tend his own garden.
They knew that such fluctuations were merely the harmless whispers of the void, not deceit.
casting all five pearls across the Great Abyss

note: Every round: all five cast, keeper returns half (7 or 7.5); noise read as wind not deceit; no sanction.
